name: LQS - Qualification: save answers
description: Stateful. In: conversation_id, slots_json. Out: { ok, saved, conflicts }. Upserts one row per slot; a materially different value on an already filled slot pushes the old value into previous_values and marks the slot conflicted. Contact is additive.

parameters.query: select sd.slot_key as slot_key, sd.value_type as value_type, q.value as current_value, q.state as current_state, coalesce(q.previous_values, '[]'::jsonb) as previous_values, m.currency as market_currency, m.fx_rates as fx_rates, l.full_name as lead_full_name from lqs.conversations c join lqs.leads l on l.id = c.lead_id join lqs.markets m on m.id = c.market_id join lqs.slot_definitions sd on sd.market_id = c.market_id and sd.deal_type = c.deal_type left join lqs.qualification q on q.conversation_id = c.id and q.slot_key = sd.slot_key where c.id = $1::uuid;

with upserted as (insert into lqs.qualification (conversation_id, slot_key, value, state, previous_values, updated_at) select $1::uuid, x.slot_key, x.value, x.state, x.previous_values, now() from jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) as x(slot_key text, value jsonb, state text, previous_values jsonb) on conflict (conversation_id, slot_key) do update set value = excluded.value, state = excluded.state, previous_values = excluded.previous_values, updated_at = now() returning slot_key, state, value), lead_sync as (update lqs.leads l set full_name = coalesce(nullif(l.full_name, ''), nullif(u.value->>'full_name', '')), phone = coalesce(nullif(l.phone, ''), nullif(u.value->>'phone', '')), email = coalesce(nullif(l.email, ''), nullif(case when u.value->>'email' like '%_@_%._%' then lower(u.value->>'email') end, '')), updated_at = now() from upserted u, lqs.conversations c where u.slot_key = 'contact' and c.id = $1::uuid and l.id = c.lead_id returning l.id) select coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('slot_key', slot_key, 'state', state)) from upserted), '[]'::json) as results;
